data.narrative:
Velaura AI is a Series C semiconductor company that has raised $343M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 8 private and 3 public comparables in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, including Tenstorrent, Nearfield Instruments, Positron AI, and DEEPX at similar or adjacent stages.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $583M. Peer-Median anchoring across the 4 same-sector comparables—which trade at a range of $529M to $2.7B—produces a $1.3B implied valuation. Public-Comp anchoring cannot be applied; while the public semiconductor universe (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) shows a median P/S of 20.4x, Velaura's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulation of two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $496M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $942M. The wide spread reflects material stage and maturity variance within the peer set: DEEPX trades at $529M as a Series C peer, while Series D comparables (Tenstorrent, Nearfield) command $1.6B–$2.7B. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, proprietary technology defensibility, and customer concentration—typical opacity for private semiconductor ventures at this stage.
